set_by.description: Person in the owning Design Sub-team who set the lead Sub-system

approved_by.description: A Design Lead whose area is lead_sub_system, at approved_at

change_record.description: Change Record (change type Lead Sub-system change) when the lead was changed after creation

lead_sub_system_approval.description: R-15: the lead Sub-system is set by the owning Design Sub-team and approved by a Design Lead of that Sub-system. A change is a Change Record (VR-CHG-0011) that re-runs interface inheritance and flags existing breaks for re-confirmation.

fdps_interface.description: R-18: true for a flag raised to the owner of the other FDPS by a cross-FDPS Secures link. Its decision is Accept or Query; a Query stays open, is shown on both FDPS pages and does not block the link. No confirmation of the link is required.
